g.text: Every input document uses an independently asserted source SHA
and a normalized complete-document closure digest.
A focused validator cannot close another proof class.
One row never stands for multiple live facts.
Ambiguous test areas remain unresolved and blocked.
Frozen ownership and ordering do not close debt.
Strict success is unavailable until every Phase 18 zero equation,
proof class, budget, claim, and execution obligation is closed.
